item.title: How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)
item.description:
How to Build a Comprehensive Government Website for the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Directorate (SLFA)

A modern government website is more than an online brochure. It is a platform for transparency, accountability, public communication, and citizen services.

For the Sikkim Local Fund Audit (SLFA), the website should serve as the official source of information relating to local fund audits, audit reports, statutory provisions, annual reports, RTI disclosures, circulars, publications, and citizen services.

item.title: Build an Excel Pay Fixation Calculator Under CCS (Revised Pay) Rules Using a Pay Matrix
item.description:
Build an Excel Pay Fixation Calculator Using the Pay Matrix

Pay fixation after promotion is one of the most frequently performed calculations in Government offices. Although the rules are straightforward, manually comparing both fixation options is time-consuming and often leads to mistakes.

This guide explains how to create an Excel-based Pay Fixation Calculator that automatically calculates both permissible options under the revised pay rules and recommends the financially better option.

item.title: Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator
item.description:
Building a Sikkim Pay Fixation Calculator: Understanding Rule 12 and Developing a Web-Based Promotion Pay Calculator

Government employees are often confused about how their pay is fixed after promotion. Although the Sikkim Government Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 provide detailed provisions, manually calculating the revised pay can be time-consuming and prone to errors.

In this project, we built a web-based Pay Fixation Calculator that follows Rule 12 of the Sikkim Revised Pay Rules, 2018 and uses the official Pay Matrix for automatic calculations.

item.title: Creating a Comprehensive Manual for Sikkim Local Fund Audit: A Practical Guide for Auditors
item.description:
Creating a Comprehensive Manual for Sikkim Local Fund Audit

A well-prepared audit manual is one of the most valuable reference documents for auditors. It establishes uniform audit procedures, promotes consistency in audit reporting, and serves as a practical guide for newly appointed as well as experienced audit officers.

The objective of a Manual for Sikkim Local Fund Audit is to standardize audit methodology for Local Bodies, Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs), Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), Autonomous Bodies, Government-Aided Institutions, and other organizations whose accounts are subject to audit under the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Act and the corresponding Rules.

item.title: Drafting Office Notings and Official Letters for Submission of the Annual Consolidated Audit Report to the Legislature
item.description:
Drafting Office Notings and Official Letters for Submission of the Annual Consolidated Audit Report

Government correspondence demands clarity, precision, and compliance with statutory provisions. One such important communication is the submission of the Annual Consolidated Audit Report (ACAR) to the State Legislature.

Under the Sikkim Local Fund Audit Act, 2012, the Directorate of Local Fund Audit is required to prepare and submit the Annual Consolidated Audit Report for laying before the State Legislature. This process generally involves preparing an office noting seeking approval, forwarding authenticated and printed copies to the Legislative Assembly Secretariat, and uploading electronic copies wherever prescribed.

item.title: RTI Online Portal Training at NIC Sikkim: Complete Guide for SPIOs, ASPIOs and Nodal Officers
item.description:
RTI Online Portal Training at NIC Sikkim

On 25 June 2025, officials from various government departments attended a training programme conducted by the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Sikkim on the implementation and use of the RTI Online Portal.

The session focused on the complete lifecycle of an RTI application, user roles, workflow management, role assignment, and the responsibilities of various officers under the Right to Information Act.

This article summarizes the training and serves as a reference guide for future users of the RTI Online Portal.

Introduction

Drawing and Disbursing Officers (DDOs) and Accounts Officers (AOs) play a critical role in maintaining financial discipline within government departments. Every expenditure, salary payment, procurement, grant, and utilization certificate ultimately passes through their hands.
